name: av_acc_ode_only_unknown_is_not_analytic
source:
{ An accessor constraint whose only unknown lives inside the DYNAMIC block:
  `augmentAccessorDependencies` adds `+ 0*v` only for variables the ANALYTIC
  system already has, so `kk` never becomes one and the document is
  overspecified. Contrast fixtures/corpus-pending/dyn_accessor_live, where the
  tie `k = kmin + dk` puts the unknown in the analytic system. }
Tinf = 20
Temp0 = 95

FinalValue('Temp') = 60

DYNAMIC cooling (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 1, points = 3)
  der(Temp) = -kk*(Temp - Tinf)
  Temp(0) = Temp0
END

error.message: There are 3 equations and 2 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relation (no free variable left to determine): FinalValue('Temp')=60. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
